metadata.title: The secular tidal disruption of stars by low-mass Super Massive Black Holes secondaries in galactic nuclei

notes: No eligible individual stars are identified. The paper studies simulated, unnamed stars in an SMBH–IMBH system, and its discussion of Galactic hypervelocity stars is population-level rather than an analysis of a specific star identified as a Galactic unbound candidate (e.g., T:p4-b3, T:p8-b4).
